premise: After the long night a stripe of white sunlight sweeps across the plain, and the whole base wakes up, one thing after another.
inspiration: Chanticleer the rooster of Chaucer and the fables, who crows the sun up, turned: there is no rooster on the Moon — just a stripe of light that wakes everyone in turn.
lesson: Every new day reaches everyone in the end.

en-US.title: The Base Wakes Up
en-US.text: [whispers] Shhh. It's the end of the long Moon night, and everything is fast asleep. {all:face sleeping} [short pause] {canvas:daybreak} Then, there! A stripe of white light slides over the far ridge. {all:pulse 0.4} It sweeps across the plain, {canvas:glints 0.5 8s} and every pebble glints. It reaches the landing pad. {sfx:chime} Ping! Its little lights blink. {all:shake 0.3} It reaches the radio mast, and the big dish shines. It reaches the habitat's round window, and the window glows. {all:glow 0.5} [happily] And then it reaches everyone out on the plain. {all:face happy} {all:hop} [yawns] Stretch! {all:wobble} Wiggle! {all:spin} {all:sparkle} Good morning, Moon. Good morning, everyone. The long day has begun.

es-ES.title: La base se despierta
es-ES.text: [whispers] Chsss. Se acaba la noche en la Luna, y todo está profundamente dormido. {all:face sleeping} [short pause] {canvas:daybreak} Y entonces, ¡mira! Una franja de luz blanca asoma por las montañas. {all:pulse 0.4} Recorre la llanura, {canvas:glints 0.5 8s} y cada piedrecita brilla. Llega a la plataforma de aterrizaje. {sfx:chime} ¡Ping! Sus lucecitas parpadean. {all:shake 0.3} Llega al mástil de la radio, y la gran parabólica reluce. Llega a la ventana redonda del módulo, y la ventana se ilumina. {all:glow 0.5} [happily] Y por fin llega a todos los que están en la llanura. {all:face happy} {all:hop} [yawns] ¡A estirarse! {all:wobble} ¡A menearse! {all:spin} {all:sparkle} Buenos días, Luna. Buenos días a todos. Ha empezado el largo día.

chime.prompt: a single soft bright electronic ping, like a small light switching on
